package tempo

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/golang/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/grafana/grafana-plugin-sdk-go/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	tracev1 "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var repo = os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")

func read(t *testing.T, p string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return b
}
func TestPulseFrames(t *testing.T) {
	var response tempopb.TraceByIDResponse
	if e := proto.Unmarshal(read(t, repo+"/test/fixtures/traces/tempo-v2-trace.protobuf"), &response); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	// Actual Tempo v2.9.0 Parquet conversion independently proves stored output
	// materializes default status. Preserve the official fixture's other ordering.
	for _, rs := range response.Trace.ResourceSpans {
		for _, ss := range rs.ScopeSpans {
			for _, s := range ss.Spans {
				if s.Status == nil {
					s.Status = &tracev1.Status{}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, v := range []struct {
		Name    string
		Message proto.Message
	}{{"tempo-v2-stored-trace", &response}, {"tempo-v1-stored-trace", response.Trace}} {
		wire, e := proto.Marshal(v.Message)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/"+v.Name+".protobuf", wire, 0644); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		m := jsonpb.Marshaler{}
		if e = m.Marshal(&buf, v.Message); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		raw := buf.Bytes()
		if strings.Contains(v.Name, "v1") {
			raw = bytes.Replace(raw, []byte(`"resourceSpans":`), []byte(`"batches":`), 1)
		}
		if e = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/"+v.Name+".json", raw, 0644); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	frame, e := TraceToFrame(response.Trace.ResourceSpans)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if frame.Rows() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("lookup rows %d", frame.Rows())
	}
	actual, e := json.Marshal(frame)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/lookup-frame.json", actual, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	// Official expected wire and current native Pulse export must yield identical actual client frames.
	var exported tempopb.TraceByIDResponse
	if e := proto.Unmarshal(read(t, "/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/lookup.protobuf"), &exported); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	got, e := TraceToFrame(exported.Trace.ResourceSpans)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	gotJSON, e := json.Marshal(got)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if string(gotJSON) != string(actual) {
		t.Fatalf("lookup frame differs: %s vs %s", gotJSON, actual)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Name     string          `json:"name"`
		Response json.RawMessage `json:"response"`
	}
	if e = json.Unmarshal(read(t, repo+"/test/fixtures/traces/tempo-search-oracle.json"), &cases); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	ctx := backend.PluginContext{DataSourceInstanceSettings: &backend.DataSourceInstanceSettings{UID: "fixture-tempo", Name: "Fixture Tempo"}}
	outputs := make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var expected, actual tempopb.SearchResponse
			if e := jsonpb.Unmarshal(strings.NewReader(string(c.Response)), &expected); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if e := proto.Unmarshal(read(t, "/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/"+c.Name+".protobuf"), &actual); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			// Only equal-start upstream ties are unspecified. Match Pulse's documented ID tie order.
			for _, r := range []*tempopb.SearchResponse{&expected, &actual} {
				sort.Slice(r.Traces, func(i, j int) bool {
					a, b := r.Traces[i], r.Traces[j]
					if a.StartTimeUnixNano == b.StartTimeUnixNano {
						return a.TraceID < b.TraceID
					}
					return a.StartTimeUnixNano > b.StartTimeUnixNano
				})
			}
			want, e := transformTraceSearchResponse(ctx, &expected)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			got, e := transformTraceSearchResponse(ctx, &actual)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			wantJSON, e := json.Marshal(want)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			gotJSON, e := json.Marshal(got)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if string(wantJSON) != string(gotJSON) {
				t.Fatalf("actual client frame mismatch: %s vs %s", gotJSON, wantJSON)
			}
			outputs[c.Name] = wantJSON
		})
	}
	out, e := json.MarshalIndent(outputs, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/search-frames.json", out, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
